evidence:
Shared-state topology: tests/test.sh launches ONE app process and runs `rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1` for suite gates then suite scored against it; the only restart is the single-use restart_app inside hro_intake_restart. Functional is mode = "individual" (functional/judge.toml line 3), so 15 sequential sessions plus gates, polish and visual all mutate the same database. Every functional/polish/visual session also runs a 'Global browser gate' that adds a card to the seeded Data Analyst Applied (functional/prompt.md line 15; polish/prompt.md line 11; visual/prompt.md line 11), and gates/constraints adds one too (constraints/judge.toml line 25). Applied has no capacity rule, so these ~18 accumulating cards do not break later checks.

What the task does well (state-relative wording present): app_context.md: 'Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count.' functional/prompt.md line 21 'Shared state': 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board step (suffix every job title and candidate name for this session), never move records you did not create, and never rely on a starting count except where your criterion quotes a seeded fact', plus 'If a message or note box already holds text you did not type in this session, record it and clear it' (handles leftover drafts from hro_long_thread / polish). polish/prompt.md line 14 repeats the own-job and clear-leftover-draft rules; visual is read-only ('Do not move cards or send messages', 'a seeded job is fine'). hro_long_thread (judge.toml line 141) reads Noor's PE thread relative ('earlier sessions may have added messages to it; read counts relative to what it holds'); hro_activity filters to its own job; hro_unread_seen and hro_messaging measure rises 'by exactly two' on a new conversation.

Seeded facts still quoted absolutely, checked for protection: (a) hro_intake_restart line 33 quotes the seeded Platform Engineer order (Applied Greta, Ade, Marco; Screen Priya, Samuel) and Noor's note - matches seed APP-105/106/108/103/104 and notes[0]; no gate, functional, polish or visual step moves PE cards or adds PE notes, and 'never move records you did not create' / visual 'Do not move cards' protect it. (b) hro_unread_seen line 150 'Lena's count is 1' - seed reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages; functional/prompt.md line 21 bans messaging Lena's PD conversation and signing in as Lena, polish/prompt.md line 24 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', render gate opens no conversation. (c) hro_candidate line 159 quotes Noor PE Interviewing, Noor PD Application received, Tomas DA In review - seed APP-101 INTERVIEW, APP-302 APPLIED, APP-201 SCREEN; no step moves those seeded cards and the Bar says 'including' so extra Tomas applications from hro_messaging/hro_unread_seen are tolerated. These are protected.

DEFECT (fallback path assumes free Interview places in the seeded Product Designer job): functional/prompt.md line 21: 'Where your criterion needs a job and no job can be opened through the UI (opening is graded only in hro_intake_restart), use the seeded Product Designer job with your own suffixed cards ... read places, orders and counts relative to its state before you act'. Seed JOB-DSGN interview_limit 3 with Bruno Alves (APP-303) already in Interview. The same prompt forbids moving 'records you did not create'. Every Interview-using criterion run on that fallback leaves its own cards in PD Interview: hro_reject_reopen (line 51) ends with F reopened into Interview and G there -> Bruno, G, F = 3/3 full; hro_interview_places (line 69) ends with B and E in Interview plus Bruno = 3/3. After either, the next fallback session cannot move anything into PD Interview and is forbidden to free a place. 'Relative' reading cannot create a free place, and the leave-the-leg-out clause covers only setup prevented by 'a feature that another criterion grades', not capacity consumed by earlier sessions, and 'applies only to setup for a leg the Bar does not itself grade'. Affected later legs: hro_interview_places control 'A and B entering Interview' (5.5), hro_bulk step 6 control 'select V and X and move them to Interview' (5), hro_undo step 4 V-and-X to Interview (5), hro_manager_roles 'three in Interview' setup (4); polish hro_pol_live_board's other recruiter moves the Screen card 'to Interview' and the row is 0 if no update arrives (polish/judge.toml), which in the fallback is a refused move into the full PD Interview. All are binary, so each criterion goes to 0.

Minor (P3, same fallback family): hro_unread_seen line 150 fallback ('use his seeded Data Analyst conversation ... with counts relative to their values before you act') keeps the absolute leg 'Mei's count equals the messages in it not written by her (she has not opened it)'. In the seed Mei (USR-REC2) has read_count 1 on APP-201, and hro_messaging's fallback (line 123) has Mei write in that same conversation, so the parenthetical premise is false and a correct app's relative unread count would not equal the total of non-Mei messages.

Runtime: the raw evidence index scope states 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent' and the scripted golden driver 'does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would'. No sequential full-suite run against shared state exists, so inter-session tolerance on the main (non-fallback) path is source-reviewed only, NOT EXERCISED at runtime.
counterexample: Take the golden app and break only the open-job action (the form posts but the server refuses every new job, or the button does nothing). Every other feature is correct. hro_intake_restart loses its job-opening leg as intended. hro_reject_reopen then falls back to the seeded Product Designer job and ends with Bruno, G and F in its Interview (3/3, the job's limit). The next fallback session, hro_interview_places, cannot move A and B into Interview, and the prompt forbids moving the earlier session's cards. So its control fails and the binary 5.5 criterion scores 0. hro_bulk (5), hro_undo (5), hro_manager_roles (4) and polish hro_pol_live_board (2) also go to 0, although their interview-limit, multi-move, undo, role and live-board behaviour is correct. One opening defect cascades into roughly 19.5 of 61 functional weight plus a polish row through shared state left by earlier sessions, not through the features being graded.
suggested_fix: In the Shared-state fallback (functional/prompt.md line 21, mirrored in polish/prompt.md line 24), tell the judge to first move any suffixed card from an earlier review out of the seeded Product Designer job's Interview as Rafael, so that the places the criterion needs are free. If that cannot be done, leave out the legs that need those places and record why. Also make hro_unread_seen's fallback Mei leg relative: Mei's count rises by the messages others add after a baseline read.
